reviews.text: J’avais le sérum et les patch’s pour les yeux achetés en Corée je voulais tester la brume et qui sait peut être après la crème visage !
reviews.zh: 我之前已經喺韓國買咗精華同眼膜貼片，我想試吓噴霧，講唔定之後會試面霜！

reviews.text: best seeum spray i ever used . good for dark spots and its hydrating too . this is my 5 bottle so i love it

reviews.text: I have sensitive combo skin and this irritated my skin for a while but after i stopped using it my skin got better. Its definitely amazing but it might not suit my skin.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚係敏感混合性，佢一度令我皮膚刺激，但係停咗用之後，我嘅皮膚就好返。佢真係好好，但可能唔太啱我嘅皮膚。

reviews.text: Thought I was buying the vitamin C serum, but I bought the mist instead. I keep using it to finish the bottle, but I don't feel like the results are as good as the serum.
reviews.zh: 我以為我買咗維他命 C 精華，但原來買咗噴霧。我而家用緊噴霧嚟用完支樽，但係我覺得效果唔及精華咁好。

reviews.text: I really like this mist. It gives me a really good glow. My skin looks brighter and fresher. If you want dark spot treatment: i would recommend the serum. It would give you a better finish than only using this mist alone.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款噴霧。佢令我嘅面好有光采，皮膚睇落更光亮、更清新。如果你想搞掂暗斑：我會推薦用精華。用精華嘅效果會比單獨用呢款噴霧更好。
